title: Bug Case Study: Write Data Advances During a Stall
description: The address phase for 0x18 and the data phase for 0x14 are both held by HREADY=0; the bug appears when HWDATA changes to the later transfer's value before 0x14 completes.

annotations.message: Address 0x14 is accepted while write data for 0x10 completes. The pipeline now owes D(0x14) in the following data phase.
HREADY=0 stalls data phase 0x14 and pending address phase 0x18. HADDR, HTRANS, and HWDATA must remain associated with those owners.
Address 0x18 finally owns the data phase. D(0x18) is legal here, one accepted address phase after its request.

violations.message: EARLY ADVANCE: DATA_OWNER is still 0x14, but HWDATA changed to D(0x18) after the low-HREADY cycle. The slave completes 0x14 with the wrong data.
